title: Lentil Kale Soup
description: Lentil Kale Soup is a hearty vegan recipe that is easy to throw together with green lentils, onions, celery, carrots and kale - 13 grams of protein/serving!

source.rights: Feel Good Foodie. Functional content plus a link, for internal app testing. Not redistributed.

steps.text: In a large pot, heat olive over medium high heat. Add onions and cook until translucent, about 3-5 minutes. Add the garlic, carrots and celery and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.

steps.text: Add the green lentils, cumin, coriander, salt and pepper and cook with the vegetables to lightly toast the lentils, about 5 minutes. Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil; reduce heat and then simmer on low for 30 minutes until the lentils are cooked and the broth thickens.

review.reviewBody: Newly discovered your page and can’t wait to try more of your recipes, Yumna! This soup was perfect as a quick, nutritious meal after work. Reminds me of my mom’s lentil soup and loved your addition of the kale.
So delish! I added fire roasted tomatoes which added another layer of flavor. Perfect fall go-to soup.

Wow. The seasoning on this is next level. Love it! I've tried lots of lentil soup recipes, but this is my go-to now. I used Better Than Bouillon Lower Sodium Vegetable Base to make my veggie broth. My Beiruti husband asked me to add a little potato (I boiled it separately and then added it to the finished soup) since his mom did this from time to time. Thank you Yumna!

This recipe is always the first choice for cool fall and winter lunches. We make a huge pot then freeze in smaller batches, for quick dinners or lunches. It freezes well even with the kale. Each time we take a batch out, we add our leftover veggies ( roasted sweet potatoes, or broccoli etc. from the day before ), so that each batch is packed with extra veggies and has its own unique taste. Great recipe! Have sent it to so many family and friends! Yummy!!!!

I loved this!! I added about 2 tbsp of chipotles in adobo and 1tbsp of tomato chicken bouillon to make the flavor similar to a mexican lentil soup. I loved it! So concentrated and perfect for fall weather.
Really tasty - added some crispy bacon and Parmesan on top ( not veggie), but even without it would still be lush!
So good! Used stock I made from leek tops. Added fresh jalapeño pepper and some Yukon taters. Squeezed lemon juice in before serving. Sprinkled nooch atop. Yum.
